Roasted Sweet Potato Fries

Ingredients:

  • 2 Tbsp Olive Oil
  • 2 tsp Dijon Mustard or any mustard to hand it works
  • 2 tsp honey
  • 1 tsp minced fresh Rosemary
  • 1/4 ts Salt
